subject: Request: One-off rate cap + onboarding credit for MedStream annual commitment
body:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@medstream.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pricing ask for enterprise pilot and annual commit

Kimberly / Redwood team —

Thanks again for the demo today. MedStream is excited about the latency profile you showed and the observability hooks — we can see value for a clinical notes summarization pilot. Before we proceed, procurement and finance need better clarity on large upfront cost exposure. Two asks from our side: 

1) A firm rate cap on per-token price for year 1 if we sign a 12-month, $1.2M committed ARR agreement (we're targeting 3M requests/month initially). We need the cap to be within 20% of the quoted hosted rate today.
2) A one-time onboarding credit or implementation allowance to offset integration work (~$30k).

If you can align on a simple memo with the financial concession and a draft SOW, we can move to legal and procurement next week.

Attaching a short one-pager with expected usage profile. Happy to jump on another call.

Best,
Elaine Park\Director, Product Partnerships\MedStream Health

---

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@medstream.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing ask for enterprise pilot and annual commit

Elaine —

Great to hear the pilot looks promising. We're aligned to move quickly. Internal note: MedStream is a strategic vertical account (healthcare) and this is likely an Early Access case for our private deployment discussions.

I can provide a one-off commercial concession: capped hosted per-token rate for year 1 + implementation credit, contingent on a signed 12-month commitment at $1.2M ARR and a co-marketing commitment (1 case study + joint webinar). Would you sign up for those?

I'm looping Ben (Head of Sales) and Rishi (Sales Ops/Finance) to figure the exact numbers and get VP/CFO sign-off routing. I'll send a short exception memo for approval this afternoon.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park\Account Executive, Enterprise\Redwood Inference\(415) 555-0142

Attachment: MedStream_Pricing_Request_v3.pdf (application/pdf)

---

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com; ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-01T14:18:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Pricing ask for enterprise pilot and annual commit

Kim / Ben —

Reviewed the ask. Key constraints: revenue protection (minimum ACV), precedent risk (large hosted discount early in lifecycle), and packaging (they want hosted but may later request dedicated). Proposed structure for approval memo: 

- Customer: MedStream Health (Health, US)
- Commitment: 12 months / $1.2M ARR
- Year 1 concessions requested: 20% per-token cap vs list; $30k onboarding credit; Net45 payment terms (standard is Net30)
- Redwood counter (recommended): 15% cap; $25k onboarding credit (split: $15k credit + $10k implementation service discount); Net45 for first invoice only; clause: concession applies only if signature by 2026-10-15 and SOW includes co-marketing deliverables.
- Approval ask: VP or CFO sign-off for a one-time commercial exception (non-repeatable; recorded in pricing guardrails)

I prepared a draft memo (see attached) that summarizes the trade-offs and includes suggested redlines to the SOW and a DocuSign flow. Suggest Marissa / Finance sign.

Rishi\Head of Sales Operations\Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOW_MedStream_v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

---

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-02T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing ask for enterprise pilot and annual commit

Rishi —

Thanks for the draft. A couple of points from finance perspective: 

1) The $25k credit is acceptable if we have an upfront irrevocable commitment clause (monthly minimums) and a clawback if they under-deliver on usage by 40% in the first 90 days.
2) We should structure the discount as a blended effective rate (so it doesn't read as an ongoing % off list that sales can replicate). Put the concession in a named exception file with signatory: VP Revenue + CFO.
3) Net45 is fine for the first invoice, but require ACH/electronic payment and a single upfront deposit (10% of ACV) to cover ramp costs.

If we formalize those, I can route to Finance leadership for sign-off today. Mark this as time-limited (signature by 10/15).

Marissa Cole\VP, Finance\Redwood Inference

---

From: ben_carter@redwood.com <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-02T14:36:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing ask for enterprise pilot and annual commit

Team —

I support Marissa's controls. My recommendation for the memo to VP/CFO: approve the concession with the following hard lines: 1) single-use exception, 2) co-marketing deliverable (public case study) signed into SOW, 3) 10% deposit, 4) usage clawback at 90 days as Marissa outlined.

I'll escalate for final sign-off. Kim — once you confirm MedStream accepts the clawback/marketing asks, I'll take this up with the VP and CFO.

Ben Carter\Head of Sales, Enterprise\Redwood Inference

---

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@medstream.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-03T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing ask for enterprise pilot and annual commit

Elaine —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. MedStream, we have internal agreement to offer a one-time commercial exception under the following terms: 

- Commitment: 12 months / $1.2M ARR (signed SOW + order form)
- Year 1: capped effective hosted rate equivalent to ~15% below today's list pricing (applies to tokens generated on hosted plan only)
- Onboarding allowance: $25,000 (applied as one-time credit on first invoice)
- Payment: 10% deposit on signature, remainder Net45 for first invoice; standard Net30 thereafter
- Marketing: one joint case study + webinar to be completed within 6 months of go-live (SOW clause)
- Usage clawback: if billed usage in first 90 days < 60% of forecasted usage, Redwood reserves the right to reclaim a pro-rated portion of the onboarding allowance or convert to standard pricing for remainder of term per the clawback schedule in the memo.
- Approval: one-time exception approved pending signatures (VP Revenue + CFO).

If that aligns, please confirm and we will send a redlined SOW + exception memo and DocuSign packet. We need signature by 2026-10-15 to preserve the concession.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park\Account Executive, Enterprise\Redwood Inference

-----

On Fri, Oct 3, 2026 at 15:45 Elaine Park <elaine.park@medstream.com> wrote:

Kimberly / Ben —

Thanks — that is much closer to what we need. Two quick clarifications: 
1) Can the credit be applied to professional services invoices if we pay a services vendor directly?
2) Do you have a short memo we can share internally (procurement) that lists the approval path you mentioned?

If yes on both, we'll sign the SOW early next week.

Best,
Elaine
